input_0.title: Normalize Operations
input_0.detail:
enableCache: false
cacheTTL: 60
resultTable: op_invoice_normalized
sql:
SELECT
  i.*,
  CASE i.UoM
    WHEN 'kg' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'liter' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'metric_ton' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'lb' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 0.45359237, 6)
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 3.78541, 6)
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 0.907185, 6)
    ELSE ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
  END AS Qty_Normalized,
  CASE i.UoM
    WHEN 'lb' THEN 'kg'
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN 'liter'
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN 'metric_ton'
    ELSE i.UoM
  END AS UoM_Normalized,
  CASE i.Currency
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'EUR' THEN fx.USD_EUR WHEN 'GBP' THEN fx.USD_GBP
    WHEN 'JPY' THEN fx.USD_JPY WHEN 'NOK' THEN fx.USD_NOK WHEN 'CHF' THEN fx.USD_CHF WHEN 'SEK' THEN fx.USD_SEK
  END AS Rate,
  ROUND(i.TotalAmount / CASE i.Currency
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'EUR' THEN fx.USD_EUR WHEN 'GBP' THEN fx.USD_GBP
    WHEN 'JPY' THEN fx.USD_JPY WHEN 'NOK' THEN fx.USD_NOK WHEN 'CHF' THEN fx.USD_CHF WHEN 'SEK' THEN fx.USD_SEK END, 2) AS TotalAmount_USD
FROM op_invoice_raw i
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM op_fx_rates f
  ORDER BY ABS(date_diff('day', i.Date, f.Date))
  …

input_0.title: Operations Snapshot
input_0.detail:
enableCache: false
cacheTTL: 60
resultTable: q_operations_snapshot
sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount_USD), 2) AS total_spend_usd,
  COUNT(*) AS invoice_count,
  ROUND(AVG(TotalAmount_USD), 2) AS avg_invoice_usd,
  COUNT(DISTINCT Vendor) AS unique_vendors,
  CAST(20 + floor(random() * 31) AS INTEGER) AS simulated_throughput,
  CAST(3 + floor(random() * 26) AS INTEGER) AS simulated_queue,
  CAST(180 + floor(random() * 470) AS INTEGER) AS simulated_latency_ms,
  CAST(90 + floor(random() * 10) AS INTEGER) AS simulated_health_score,
  strftime(current_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') AS refreshed_at
FROM op_invoice_normalized

input_1.title: Linked Ops Pulse
input_1.detail:
enableCache: false
cacheTTL: 60
resultTable: q_linked_ops_pulse
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM op_invoice_normalized
)
SELECT
  strftime(current_timestamp - i * INTERVAL '1 minute', '%H:%M') AS minute,
  CAST(18 + floor(random() * 35) + (invoice_count * 0) AS INTEGER) AS invoices_per_min,
  CAST(4 + floor(random() * 28) AS INTEGER) AS queue_depth,
  CAST(170 + floor(random() * 520) AS INTEGER) AS latency_ms
FROM range(59, -1, -1) AS t(i)
CROSS JOIN base

input_3.title: Vendor Operations
input_3.detail:
enableCache: false
cacheTTL: 60
resultTable: q_vendor_operations
sql:
WITH vendor_actual AS (
  SELECT Vendor, ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount_USD), 2) AS spend_usd, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM op_invoice_normalized
  GROUP BY Vendor
), vendor_sim AS (
  SELECT *,
    CAST(floor(random() * 18) AS INTEGER) AS simulated_queue,
    CAST(8 + floor(random() * 25) AS INTEGER) AS simulated_rate,
    CAST(floor(random() * 100) AS INTEGER) AS simulated_risk
  FROM vendor_actual
)
SELECT Vendor, spend_usd, invoice_count, simulated_queue, simulated_rate, simulated_risk,
  CASE WHEN simulated_risk >= 85 THEN 'Watch' WHEN simulated_risk >= 65 THEN 'Elevated' ELSE 'Healthy' END AS simulated_status
FROM vendor_sim
ORDER BY spend_usd DESC
